| # Object 0x1018 identity object {#object-0x1018-identity-object-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object contains general information about the device.

 

 

  Index       0x1018
  ----------- -----------------
  Name        Identity Object
  Object      Record
  Data Type   Identity
  Category    Mandatory

 

 

SubIndex Supported

  SubIndex        0
  --------------- -------------------
  Description     number of entries
  Access          RO
  Value Range     NA
  Default Value   4

 

 

  SubIndex        1
  --------------- -------------------------
  Description     Vendor ID as per CiA
  Access          RO
  Value Range     NA
  Default Value   0x24 (Bosch Rexroth AG)

 

  SubIndex        2
  --------------- -----------------------------
  Description     Product number
  Access          RO
  Value Range     NA
  Default Value   Hardware code of the device

 

  SubIndex        3
  --------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  Description     Revision number
  Access          RO
  Value Range     NA
  Default Value   Change revision AE (Automotive Electronics) excluding Alphabet \'R\'

 

  SubIndex        4
  --------------- ------------------------------
  Description     Serial number
  Access          RO
  Value Range     NA
  Default Value   Serial number of the device.

 

 

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
